method: Supabase MCP migration application and read-only SQL verification
query: select current_database() as database_name, current_user as database_user, (select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public' and table_name like 'shared_tax_reporting_%') as reporting_tables, (select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public' and table_name in ('shared_company_tax_rule_catalogs','shared_company_tax_rules','shared_tax_counterparty_profiles','shared_taxation_configuration_idempotency','shared_supplier_invoice_matches')) as taxation_and_match_tables, (select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('shared_tax_reporting_fact_append','shared_tax_reporting_fact_list','read_iva_legacy_sources','save_native_company_tax_rule_catalog','get_native_tax_counterparty_profile','shared_supplier_invoice_match_confirm_with_tax_fact','confirm_native_sales_invoice_with_document_series_and_tax_fact_secure','confirm_native_sales_invoice_tax_issuance_secure')) as expected_iva_functions;
limitations: Schema and grants were checked through MCP; application RPC behavior, real concurrent retries, and transaction rollback were not exercised against live business records.

The original sales issuance function name exceeded PostgreSQL's 63-byte identifier limit and was truncated in PostgreSQL. Migration 368 adds a short RPC alias and the sales adapter now calls that alias.
